title: Planning gives each condition of a goal clause its own planted case, so a check that reads one condition does not pass the clause
goal: Sprint planning maps a goal clause with two conditions to checks that plant each one: ST-ksznk2zt's clause 'good with no check: line for sc_present and sc_stale' was read by a test that plants only a route disagreement, so scenario_pack shipped reading no check: line and passed every check (found by the SP-j2jn5ue4 review as BG-4flop3jv).
